verdict.rationale: Cekura ships Cekura Skills + an official MCP server so AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot) can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations via natural-language commands, plus a CLI/SDK for terminal and programmatic control, explicitly documented for agent integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of natural-language command execution and broader third-party corroboration beyond one HN comment.
